name: Reinforced mounting
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; recipe and mechanical effects provisional
description: Strengthens a compatible mounting interface; does not itself grant a new attack.

name: Concealed storage
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; recipe and mechanical effects provisional
description: Adds concealed internal storage to appropriate housing; storage capacity remains to be authored.

name: Tether deployment adaptation
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; recipe and mechanical effects provisional
description: Adds a tether deployment mechanism to a compatible equipment mount or manipulator.

name: Environmental sealing
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; recipe and mechanical effects provisional
description: Adds environmental barriers to an appropriate casing or housing; protection parameters remain unapproved.

name: Specialized grip
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; recipe and mechanical effects provisional
description: Adapts a compatible manipulator for an authored gripping function.

name: Vibration-sensing interface
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Adapts sensory hardware to register physical vibration. Does not independently grant tremorsense, a detection radius, or visibility through barriers.

name: Active ranging interface
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Provides active sonar-like or pulse-ranging hardware for compatible sensors. Blindsight, emission restrictions, and detection distance are not granted by the enhancement alone.

name: Magical sensing interface
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Supports appropriate magical detection hardware when powered and separately authorized. It does not automatically cast a spell or reveal all magic.

name: Target-acquisition interface
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Adds sensor processing useful for tracking or aiming; attack bonuses, advantage, and target visibility require separate combat or sensing rules.

name: Clawed gripping surface
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Adapts a manipulator to grip with shaped claws; no weapon attack, climbing speed, or special damage is automatically granted.

name: Precision control linkage
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Enables fine control of an installed manipulator when sufficient actuator and control support is present; it grants no ability-score, tool, or skill bonus by itself.

name: Interchangeable tool coupling
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Provides a mechanical connection for fitted tools; does not supply a tool, proficiency, free hand, or action-economy exception.

name: Hazard-adapted lining
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Provides a layer that can be configured for an authored hazard. No resistance, immunity, damage reduction, or environmental protection is granted without an approved material effect.

name: Energy absorption interface
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Adds an absorption pathway to protective hardware or energy storage. No damage negation, stored power gain, or healing occurs without an authored conversion rule.

name: Protective coverage adaptation
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Adjusts the arrangement and coverage of protective surfaces; region coverage and Armor Class must be resolved by separate physical and armor rules.

name: Programmed instructions
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Enables an authored limited instruction set for control hardware without providing consciousness, independent turns, or arbitrary autonomous behavior.

name: Supervisory control link
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Allows a controller to coordinate other control nodes or devices under a future command protocol; does not itself create a shared pool of actions.

name: Remote command receiver
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Provides a physical input for remote instructions; the range, authority, signal security, and control effects require separately authored mechanics.

name: Occupant protection interface
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Provides a supported means of securing occupants within a compatible compartment or platform; no automatic saving throw, damage reduction, or crash protection.

name: Compartment access mechanism
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Adds a mechanical access opening or hatch to an interior; does not grant a free action to enter or leave, nor modify creature capacity.

name: Environmental support interface
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Provides fittings for a controllable internal environment. Air supply, pressure control, heating, and resource consumption must be separately authored.

name: Operator control station fittings
rulesStatus: candidate enhancement; manufacturing cost, power needs, and mechanical effects not authorized
description: Provides an accessible interface for an operator in a crew or platform area. Pilot proficiency, command priority, and action use are governed independently.
